inputs.text: [excited] Here comes the Cretaceous! [happily] A hundred million years ago. [chuckles] Its name comes from "chalk," [playful] that soft white rock you can still see in cliffs today.
[curious] Did the continents look like they do today?
[amazed] [pauses] Almost! [calm] The Atlantic Ocean is already wide, [softly] and a long sea splits North America in two, [happily] from one end to the other.
[gasps] A sea in the middle of a continent?
[chuckles] A whole sea! [calm] The weather is mild, [softly] nice almost everywhere.
[curious] Were there flowers?
[happily] For the first time ever, [gasps] yes! [excited] Flowers everywhere, [playful] and little bees flying from one to the next!
[amazed] Bees, with the dinosaurs?
[chuckles] With the dinosaurs! [happily] The world turns colorful, and it smells good.
[curious] Were there dinos everywhere?
[excited] Everywhere! [shouts] In North America, Tyrannosaurus and Triceratops! [softly] One hunted, [calm] and the other defended itself with three horns.
[curious] What about Spinosaurus?
[serious] It lived by the water. [calm] With a sail on its back, [softly] it fished in the rivers, [playful] kind of like a bear catching salmon.
[curious] Was Velociraptor huge?
[chuckles] Not at all! [calm] Barely bigger than a big dog, [softly] covered in feathers, [playful] like a fast, clever turkey.
[hesitant] Really? [pauses] I thought it was giant.
[gently] That's a movie myth. [calm] The real one was small, [softly] but very smart, [happily] and it hunted in a group.
[curious] What about the sky and the sea?

[excited] Pteranodon soared way up high, [calm] a flying reptile with no feathers at all, [softly] and a beak with no teeth. [pauses] And in the ocean, [amazed] Mosasaurus ruled, [softly] a sea reptile as long as a building lying on its side.
[gasps] And the one with the horns?
[happily] [pauses] Oh yes! [excited] There he is: Triceratops, [gently] with three horns and a big frill around his neck.
[excited] Is he really there?
[happily] Really there. [calm] But one day, [pauses] everything is about to change, all at once…
